summary: On the control/structure endpoint, how tightly the output has to follow the geometry of the input image. 0 is the least influence and 1 the most, so unlike strength, higher means closer to the reference. Stability's default is 0.7.
combines: Lixpi pins it to 0.9 (STRUCTURE_CONTROL_STRENGTH, stability-provider.ts:29), well above Stability's default, so composition is held very close to the reference.
Its sense is opposite to strength: raise control_strength to stay near the reference, raise strength to get away from it.
Only reaches the API on the direct v2beta path. Bedrock has no control endpoint, so the Bedrock route substitutes the image-to-image strength constant instead.

usage.from: the pipeline-owned STRUCTURE_CONTROL_STRENGTH constant, fixed at 0.9
usage.what: Keeps a direct Stability structure-control result close to the reference geometry. Bedrock does not receive this field; that transport degrades the route to image-to-image with its own strength value.

note: Fixed internally for structure-control routing; not user-configurable.
